story:
Alistair walked deeper into the Whispering Woods, the sturdy lantern illuminating the path. The trees were ancient and tall, and he felt a dreadful sense of emptiness knowing that if he failed, everything he knew would be gone. He had to be careful not to blurt out his fears because the creatures of the forest had sharp ears. His mission was to find the legendary Crystal Cave, a place with an abundant supply of dragon magic.
He reached a quaint little hut and knocked on the door. A kindly gnome named Gus opened it. Gus had a pristine and immaculate beard. "You're looking for the egg, aren't you?" Gus asked. Alistair was devastated and distraught that his secret was known, but Gus had simply heard it from a talking squirrel. "I can help," Gus said. "You must conserve your energy for the hardest part of the journey. The path ahead is full of illusions."
Alistair thanked Gus and continued on, the forest floor feeling soft and wet. He saw a long, scaly snake slither into the bushes and a feeling of fear emerged from within him. He knew he had to be brave. A few moments later, he saw a glimmering light in the distance. The Crystal Cave! The sight was astounding and breathtaking. He was so close. He could already conceal himself behind a large rock to observe the cave entrance. He had to think of a plan before he could try to demolish the cave's magical barrier.
